scripts.draft-sheet:build: npm run draft-sheet:fetch && npm run draft-sheet:publish
scripts.draft-sheet:history: cd projects/draft-sheet && uv run python adp_history.py --force
scripts.draft-sheet:check: node --experimental-strip-types projects/draft-sheet/results/tie-out.mts && node --experimental-strip-types projects/draft-sheet/results/import.mts && node --experimental-strip-types projects/draft-sheet/results/coaching.mts && node --experimental-strip-types projects/draft-sheet/results/top200.mts && node projects/draft-sheet/results/render-board.cjs

scripts.draft-sheet:fetch: cd projects/draft-sheet && uv run python crosswalk.py --force && uv run python rankings_fpros.py --force && uv run python adp_espn.py --force && uv run python adp_yahoo.py --force && uv run python adp_ffc.py --force && uv run python adp_sleeper.py --force && uv run python merge.py
